blocks.text: Brazilian side of Iguazu, Macuco Safari and Bird Park

provenance.rationale: Extract and format the named route destinations from the exact Word section heading.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, take a tour of the Brazilian side of the falls.

The route follows the edge of the canyon. There are more than 250 cascades here. From the different viewpoints, you can watch vast volumes of water plunge into the gorge, with sunlight creating rainbows in the spray.

The main highlight is the Devil's Throat, whose height is given as approximately 80 m. A dedicated walkway leads towards the torrent, allowing you to get very close to the water.

**Iguazu Falls excursion in Brazil: Macuco Safari**

This can be added to the programme.

**Exotic Bird Park in Iguazu**

This can be visited.

At the end of the tour, your guide will take you back to the hotel.

Iguazu offers a very different experience after Rio. There is little urban scenery here: dense vegetation, humid air and the constant sound of water surround you. Children see the waterfalls from more than one viewpoint, gradually approaching them along paths, walkways and viewing platforms.
